cases.name: testHierarchyUnchanged
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    SELECT
      FROM HIERARCHY(
             SOURCE any_cds
             CHILD TO PARENT ASSOCIATION _relat
             START WHERE id = 'A'
             SIBLINGS ORDER BY id )
      FIELDS any_col,
             other_col,
             hierarchy_level
      INTO TABLE @DATA(hierarchy).

    SELECT agg~*
           FROM HIERARCHY_DESCENDANTS_AGGREGATE(
                  SOURCE HIERARCHY(
                           SOURCE any_cds
                           CHILD TO PARENT ASSOCIATION _relat
                           START WHERE id = 'A'
                           SIBLINGS ORDER BY id )
                  MEASURES MIN( num ) AS min,
                           MAX( num ) AS max,
                           SUM( num ) AS sum,
                           COUNT( * ) AS cnt
                  WHERE hierarchy_level <= @level ) AS agg
           INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_any_table).
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testWithCommonTableExpressions
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    WITH
      +any_cte AS (
        SELECT any_dtab~any_id, any_name, other_id, value_from, value_to
          FROM any_dtab
           INNER JOIN other_dtab ON other_dtab~any_id = any_dtab~any_id
          WHERE any_dtab~any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id ),

      +other_cte AS (
        SELECT any_id, other_id, SUM( any_value ) AS sum_value
          FROM third_dtab
          WHERE any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id
          GROUP BY any_id, other_id ),

      +result_cte( name, name2, name3, name4, name5 ) AS (
        SELECT any_name, c~other_id, value_from, value_to, sum_value
          FROM +any_cte AS c
            INNER JOIN +other_cte AS s ON  c~any_id = s~any_id
                                       AND c~other_id = s~other_id )

      SELECT * FROM +result_cte
        ORDER BY name, name2
        INTO TABLE @FINAL(result1).
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    WITH
      +any_cte AS (
        SELECT any_dtab~any_id, any_name, other_id, value_from, value_to
          FROM any_dtab
               INNER JOIN other_dtab ON other_dtab~any_id = any_dtab~any_id
          WHERE any_dtab~any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id ),

      +other_cte AS (
        SELECT any_id, other_id, SUM( any_value ) AS sum_value
          FROM third_dtab
          WHERE any_id BETWEEN @from_id AND @to_id
          GROUP BY any_id, other_id ),

      +result_cte( name, name2, name3, name4, name5 ) AS (
        SELECT any_name, c~other_id, value_from, value_to, sum_value
          FROM +any_cte AS c
               INNER JOIN +other_cte AS s ON  c~any_id = s~any_id
                                          AND c~other_id = s~other_id )

      SELECT * FROM +result_cte
        ORDER BY name, name2
        INTO TABLE @FINAL(result1).
  ENDMETHOD.
